mission_06: Great work! You have implemented tools to analyze potential quantum advantage in machine learning. Your entanglement entropy computation via partial trace reveals how quantum states encode correlations that are exponentially hard to represent classically. The Schmidt rank decomposition quantifies the minimum classical resources needed to approximate a quantum state. The quantum advantage indicator combines these metrics to assess whether a quantum encoding creates sufficiently complex states. While true quantum advantage requires fault-tolerant quantum computers and provably hard problems, these analysis tools help identify promising problem domains: datasets that create highly entangled quantum states with large Schmidt ranks are candidates where quantum ML may eventually outperform classical approaches.
